answer: Creating a duplicate requires re-verifying a distinct human and locking fresh stake, so a whisper of collusion from one member costs a full bond forfeiture. Each agent must stake a bonded identity whose reputation is seeded by unique proof-of-personhood attestations, like a lotus rooted once per human. Peers sample attestations across the ocean of registered identities; Sybils that reuse credentials are flagged and slashed, making mass fake accounts economically irrational.
